name: 22603 · Winchester, VA
findings: ZIP 22603 (Winchester) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22603 (Winchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22603 (Winchester) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
